cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James pitches a 'best of both worlds' value proposition: a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions.
items.quote: We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture together with leading technologies, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level.

items.text: The firm says it is unique in having the scope and breadth of products and capabilities to serve complex client needs, combined with a strong people-first culture.
items.quote: We are unique in having the scope and breadth of products and capabilities to serve complex needs of clients, combined with our strong culture that is anchored on putting people first.

items.text: In Canada, Raymond James pitches a 'best of both worlds' proposition offering a more advisor-centric culture plus the full capabilities advisors coming from banks expect.
items.quote: We have a best of both worlds value proposition in Canada... We offer a more advisor-centric culture and all the capabilities that the advisors, that most of them come from those banks have become accustomed to having.

items.text: As an employee advisor, Raymond James pitches freedom to succeed on the advisor's own terms, with no quotas and no product pushing, backed by practice resources, purpose-made technology and a powerful investment platform.
items.quote: As a Raymond James employee advisor, you're free to succeed on your terms – no quotas, no product pushing. Instead, take advantage of compelling practice resources, purpose-made technology and a powerful investment platform.

items.text: Raymond James pitches employee advisors with book ownership of their business, brand and clients.
items.quote: True partnership. We've redefined the employee advisor experience, enabled by advisor book ownership. It's your business. Your brand. Your clients. That's our promise.

items.text: Through its AdvisorChoice program, Raymond James offers advisors a platform of affiliation options, each combining support, freedom and flexibility.
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that's right for you, each offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility – and all backed by the full support of a leading independent financial firm.

items.text: Raymond James pitches its Advisor Select option as providing employee-channel benefits with the independence to create the advisor's own branch.
items.quote: Advisor Select® provides established advisors the full benefits of our employee channel with the independence to create their own branches, a powerful combination of convenience and control.

items.text: Raymond James describes its wealth platform as open architecture, bringing in the best providers across product types, including private investments.
items.quote: This is an open architecture platform for us, just like most of the rest of our wealth platform is really an open architecture platform. We bring in the best providers across all of the product types

items.text: The firm pitches its technology investment of $1 billion as a differentiator for advisors seeking a platform and a home that can remain independent.
items.quote: we're able to invest $1 billion in technology.

items.text: Raymond James pitches its commitment to remaining independent, positioning itself as a stable long-term platform and home for advisors and their clients.
items.quote: they want a platform and a home that can remain independent. And we're absolutely committed to remaining independent

items.text: The firm says it values independence to foster an environment where advisors can provide objective advice, in contrast to competitors that change compensation plans to cross-sell bank products.
items.quote: We value independence to foster an environment where our advisors can provide objective advice to their clients, whereas many of our competitors change their comp plans every year to cross-sell more bank products.

items.text: Raymond James pitches its more than $1.1 billion annual technology spend, including automation, process improvement and AI, as creating efficiencies that give advisors more time for client relationships.
items.quote: We will continue investing in automation, process improvement and AI as part of our more than $1.1 billion annual technology spend to create efficiencies, give advisers more time to deepen client relationships and further enhance the client experience.

items.text: Raymond James pitches that advisors do not have to choose between culture and capabilities, offering a client-focused culture along with leading technology, products and solutions.
items.quote: advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture along with the leading technology, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level.

cells.reason: Multiple passages explicitly describe how the firm pitches its advisor value proposition around platform (technology), products (open architecture/breadth) and autonomy (independence, book ownership, no quotas, affiliation choice).
